attributes.description: Health of all nginx instances at a glance: golden signals, a status hexmap and instance list with drill-down to Request Health, Server Internals and Traffic & Capacity, and what is breaking in the error logs. Drill into an instance from the hexmap or the tables to open its Instance Details.

embeddableConfig.description: Overview of all nginx instances.

query.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
ROW value = "Nginx-OTel" | KEEP value

SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
ROW value = "Nginx-OTel" | KEEP value

embeddableConfig.description: Opens the list of Nginx OTel dashboards in a new tab.

query.esql:
TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS `Instances` = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS `Instances` = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

embeddableConfig.description: Distinct nginx instances (host.name) that reported stub_status metrics in the selected time range. Fewer than expected means an instance or its collector stopped reporting; check Last seen in the instance table.
embeddableConfig.title: Instances reporting

query.esql:
TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND state == "active"
| STATS c = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS `Active Connections` = MAX(c)

TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND state == "active"
| STATS c = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS `Active Connections` = MAX(c)

embeddableConfig.description: Highest total of open client connections across all instances in any minute of the range (stub_status, includes idle keep-alive). Compare with worker_processes x worker_connections: approaching that limit means new connections will be dropped.
embeddableConfig.title: Peak active connections (1-min max)

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Request rate` = COUNT(*) * 1.0 / DATE_DIFF("second", TO_DATETIME(?_tstart), TO_DATETIME(?_tend))

FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Request rate` = COUNT(*) * 1.0 / DATE_DIFF("second", TO_DATETIME(?_tstart), TO_DATETIME(?_tend))

embeddableConfig.description: Requests per second across all instances, from the access log: logged requests divided by the length of the selected range, the same basis as the error rates and the instance table. A sudden drop can mean an upstream outage or lost traffic; a sudden spike can be a load surge or abuse. Server Internals shows nginx's own stub_status request counter.
embeddableConfig.title: Average request rate

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| EVAL is_error = CASE(http.response.status_code >= 500, 1, 0)
| STATS `5xx error rate` = ROUND(AVG(is_error) * 100, 1)

FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| EVAL is_error = CASE(http.response.status_code >= 500, 1, 0)
| STATS `5xx error rate` = ROUND(AVG(is_error) * 100, 1)

embeddableConfig.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status over the selected range. Green below 1%, yellow from 1%, red from 5%: clients are seeing server errors.
embeddableConfig.title: 5xx error rate (% of requests)

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.error.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND log.level IN ("error", "crit", "alert", "emerg") AND NOT message LIKE "*open() \"*\" failed (2: No such file or directory)*"
| STATS `Error-level events` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-nginx.error.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND log.level IN ("error", "crit", "alert", "emerg") AND NOT message LIKE "*open() \"*\" failed (2: No such file or directory)*"
| STATS `Error-level events` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Error-log entries at error, crit, alert or emerg level in the range, excluding the "open() ... failed (2: No such file or directory)" lines nginx writes for every 404. Any value deserves a look in the Error logs section below.
embeddableConfig.title: Total error-level log events

query.esql:
TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS `Dropped` = SUM(INCREASE(nginx.connections_accepted)) - SUM(INCREASE(nginx.connections_handled))

TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS `Dropped` = SUM(INCREASE(nginx.connections_accepted)) - SUM(INCREASE(nginx.connections_handled))

embeddableConfig.description: Connections nginx accepted but did not handle in the range (accepted minus handled). Should be 0; any value means a limit such as worker_connections was hit.
embeddableConfig.title: Total dropped connections

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS n = COUNT(*) BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS `Request rate` = AVG(n) / 60.0 BY Time = BUCKET(minute, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS n = COUNT(*) BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS `Request rate` = AVG(n) / 60.0 BY Time = BUCKET(minute, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Requests per second across all instances from the access log, averaged over the minutes in each time bucket. Compare against the usual daily shape: sudden drops or spikes need explaining.
embeddableConfig.title: Average request rate over time

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS total = COUNT(*), e5 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500, e4 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 400 AND http.response.status_code < 500 BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS t = SUM(total), s5 = SUM(e5), s4 = SUM(e4), p5 = MAX(CASE(total >= 10, e5 * 100.0 / total, NULL)) BY Time = BUCKET(minute, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `5xx error rate` = s5 * 100.0 / t, `4xx error rate` = s4 * 100.0 / t, `5xx peak (1-min)` = p5
| KEEP Time, `5xx error rate`, `5xx peak (1-min)`, `4xx error rate`

FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS total = COUNT(*), e5 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500, e4 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 400 AND http.response.status_code < 500 BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS t = SUM(total), s5 = SUM(e5), s4 = SUM(e4), p5 = MAX(CASE(total >= 10, e5 * 100.0 / total, NULL)) BY Time = BUCKET(minute, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `5xx error rate` = s5 * 100.0 / t, `4xx error rate` = s4 * 100.0 / t, `5xx peak (1-min)` = p5
| KEEP Time, `5xx error rate`, `5xx peak (1-min)`, `4xx error rate`

embeddableConfig.description: Share of requests answered with a 4xx or 5xx status in each time bucket, plus the highest one-minute 5xx share within the bucket (minutes with at least 10 requests) so short error bursts stay visible. A rising 5xx line means clients are getting server errors; a 4xx jump often means broken links, auth problems or scanners.
embeddableConfig.title: 4xx and 5xx error rate over time

embeddableConfig.description: One hexagon per nginx instance (host.name). Colour by 5xx %, 4xx %, Error logs % (error-level log events per 100 requests, excluding 404 "No such file or directory" lines) or P95 latency (per-minute P95 request duration in seconds, excluding /nginx_status; green below 0.5 s, yellow from 0.5 s, red from 1 s; Avg is the average of the per-minute values), using the minimum, maximum or last per-minute value (minutes with at least 10 requests), or the average over the range. Click a hexagon to open its instance details or its logs in Discover.

FROM metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*, logs-nginx.access.otel-*, logs-nginx.error.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND host.name IS NOT NULL
| EVAL is_m = data_stream.dataset == "nginxreceiver.otel", is_a = data_stream.dataset == "nginx.access.otel", is_e = data_stream.dataset == "nginx.error.otel"
| STATS last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) WHERE is_m,
        conns_avg = AVG(nginx.connections_current) WHERE is_m AND state == "active",
        conns_max = MAX(nginx.connections_current) WHERE is_m AND state == "active",
        requests = COUNT(*) WHERE is_a,
        e5 = COUNT(*) WHERE is_a AND http.response.status_code >= 500,
        e4 = COUNT(*) WHERE is_a AND http.response.status_code >= 400 AND http.response.status_code < 500,
        errlog = COUNT(*) WHERE is_e AND log.level IN ("error", "crit", "alert", "emerg") AND NOT message LIKE "*open() \"*\" failed (2: No such file or directory)*",
        critlog = COUNT(*) WHERE is_e AND log.level IN ("crit", "alert", "emerg"),
        p95 = PERCENTILE(http.server.request.duration, 95) WHERE is_a AND url.path != "/nginx_status"
  BY host.name
| EVAL req_rate = requests * 1.0 / DATE_DIFF("second", TO_DATETIME(?_tstart), TO_DATETIME(?_tend)),
       pct5 = CASE(requests > 0, e5 * 100.0 / requests, 0.0),
       pct4 = CASE(requests > 0, e4 * 100.0 / requests, 0.0)
| EVAL `5xx %` = ROUND(pct5, 2), `4xx %` = ROUND(pct4, 2), `Req/s` = ROUND(req_rate, 2), `P95 latency` = ROUND(p95, 3), `Avg conns` = ROUND(conns_avg, 1)
| RENAME host.name AS Instance, conns_max AS `Peak conns`, errlog AS `Error logs`, critlog AS `Crit logs`, last_seen AS `Last seen`
| SORT `5xx %` DESC, `Req/s` DESC
| KEEP Instance, `5xx %`, `4xx %`, `Req/s`, `P95 latency`, `Avg conns`, `Peak conns`, `Error logs`, `Crit logs`, `Last seen`
| LIMIT 500
